comment: Canonical v2e threshold sets. tuned_* values populated from a 1-D sweep over 5 calibration prefixes (see tools/v2e_baseline/threshold_sweep.py).

tuned_rgb.source: Stage 2 1-D sweep 2026-05-03: pos=neg=0.25 ties with 0.30 at mean_pass=4.0/5; pick 0.25 as it's the lower threshold (more events, closer to community default 0.15).

tuned_rawY.source: Stage 2 1-D sweep 2026-05-03: pos=neg=0.30 wins with mean_pass=2.4/5 (max 3/5). NOTE: rawY is intrinsically harder for v2e — even the best threshold only passes 2.4/5 K-health dims. Documented as v2e weakness on raw-domain input.
